cases.prompt: Audit a pns.yaml reconstructed from bpmn-beta text with tasks, lanes, gateways, and sequence flows but no pir.yaml.
expectations: lists recoverable and unrecoverable fields with reasons or caveats
routes the disclosed gaps to okhp3-elicitation-interviews
cases.failure_consequence: A diagram-only draft could be mistaken for an elicited and publication-ready process record.

cases.prompt: Audit a PNS whose missing fields have been filled through elicitation and whose companion pir.yaml qualifies for the validation-scoring handoff.
expectations: returns full only when every diagram boundary gap is explicitly resolved
preserves diagram-derived provenance instead of erasing it
does not claim this audit itself proves publication readiness
cases.failure_consequence: The audit could either block a sufficiently elicited process or grant publication authority it does not own.

cases.prompt: Audit a diagram-derived PNS that contains invented KPI, control, RACI, or decision-authority values not represented in the diagram.
expectations: keeps the fields classified as unrecoverable from bpmn-beta grammar
warns that populated values require source or elicitation evidence
does not silently treat plausible-looking prose as diagram evidence
routes the case for targeted elicitation or evidence review
cases.failure_consequence: Plausible fabrication could become authoritative process documentation.

holdout.note: No protected holdout set of paired bpmn-beta diagrams and independently elicited PNS records is included in this repository; do not report task uplift until one is evaluated.
